questions.question: Which data structure follows the Last In First Out (LIFO) principle?
questions.explanation: A stack follows the LIFO principle, meaning the last element inserted is the first one removed.

questions.question: What is the time complexity of binary search on a sorted array?
questions.explanation: Binary search repeatedly divides the search space in half, resulting in O(log n) time complexity.

questions.question: Which data structure is commonly used for Breadth First Search (BFS)?
questions.explanation: BFS uses a queue to process vertices level by level.

questions.question: Which sorting algorithm has an average time complexity of O(n log n)?
questions.explanation: Merge Sort divides the array recursively and merges the sorted parts, giving an average time complexity of O(n log n).

questions.question: Which data structure is used to represent hierarchical relationships?
questions.explanation: A tree is a hierarchical data structure where elements are organized in parent-child relationships.
